records.name: Project SHORT
records.summary: A student-led nonprofit that gives free admissions help to STEM students from under-resourced backgrounds who are applying to medical or graduate school. Each applicant is matched one on one with a graduate student mentor in their field.
records.what_you_do: Mentees get at least two rounds of feedback on application materials such as personal statements, plus practice interviews. Mentors are graduate students who give that help in their own field.

schedule.text: Applications are taken on a rolling basis. The site says events are held regularly but lists no dates.

cost.text: Free, as the site states for its mentoring services.

first_step.how: Apply as a student or as a mentor through the Apply page on the group's site. Applications are taken on a rolling basis.
first_step.basis: You apply before you are matched, so the way in is clear but starts with an application.

records.notes: The only date on the site is a copyright year (2023), which is not evidence, so the status rests on the working site alone. The Pre-Health and Pre-Grad mentor links on the page are placeholders with no details.

records.name: Redeemed for a Cause Outreach
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit started by a human trafficking survivor. It does street outreach to women in the sex trade, runs drop-in centers in South and West Philadelphia, and each year before Valentine's Day packs roses with encouraging notes for shelters.
records.what_you_do: Donate flowers, chocolates, or winter items for the Valentine's roses, or ask the group through its website how to volunteer for outreach or deliveries. The news coverage does not describe a formal volunteer sign-up.

cost.text: The sources read do not state prices for any service.

first_step.how: Use the group's website to ask how to volunteer or to donate items for the next Valentine's Day rose drive.
first_step.basis: The sources read do not describe a volunteer sign-up, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: Sources are two local TV news articles (dated February 10, 2024 and February 13, 2020), not the group's own site. The group's website would not load: its TLS certificate names only bluehost.com, so its own pages were not read. The newest dated item is February 2024, so status is dormant. Neighborhoods are named in the sources but no street addresses, so none are recorded. Founder name left out on purpose. IRS listing address: 730 and 732 West Moyamensing Ave.

records.name: Rousseau Foundation
records.summary: A small charity that gives meals and non-perishable food to older adults and people in underserved communities facing food insecurity, and offers culinary scholarships to aspiring chefs.
records.what_you_do: Donate to the holiday senior meals and culinary scholarship fundraiser, or write to the founder to ask how to help. The site does not list volunteer shifts.

cost.text: The site does not say whether meals or classes cost anything. Donations are taken by PayPal or by mail.

first_step.how: Email hrousseau@rousseaufoundation.org to ask how to help with the next holiday senior meals or the scholarship fundraiser.
first_step.basis: The site has no volunteer or attendance details, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The only dated item is an October 2020 radio segment. The newsletter sign-up shows a storage error message. The LinkedIn link on the page is a personal profile, so it was left out. Check whether the group still runs its meals before showing it.

records.name: Sisterhood 4 Vets
records.notes: The group's website returned HTTP 522 (Retry-After 120 seconds) on three attempts spread over the run, so no page was read. Nothing is known beyond the IRS listing (1516 S Cleveland St). Needs a later pass.

records.name: Sisters Giving Back
records.summary: A community nonprofit, started in 2011, that helps girls and young women build confidence, plan for college, and grow into leaders. It gives scholarships and runs leadership programs and yearly conferences.
records.what_you_do: Sign up for the six-month leadership cohort, register for the STEM conference or the teen girls conference, or ask the group how to volunteer. Scholarship applications are accepted through April 30, 2027.

schedule.text: A six-month leadership cohort runs October 2026 to April 2027. The STEM conference is Saturday, November 21, 2026, 9:30 am to 4 pm. The teen girls conference is held each October, and scholarships are awarded at a spring gala.

cost.text: The site does not list prices for the cohort or the conferences.

first_step.how: Register for the STEM Conference on Saturday, November 21, 2026, through the registration form on the group's site, or use the Become a Member link to join.
first_step.basis: Events and membership have clear sign-up links, but the site does not describe what a first event is like.

records.notes: Upcoming dated items are the October 2026 cohort and the November 21, 2026 conference. The newest past item is an April 19, 2026 bingo event. No email is published. The June 2025 gala was held in Deptford, New Jersey, outside Philadelphia.

records.name: Tasker Street Baptist Church Community Outreach
records.notes: The website field held an accounting firm's name, not a web address, so no site was fetched. One search found an undated Philadelphia Tribune article about Tasker Street Missionary Baptist Church (phillytrib.com, article f27433fe). Its search excerpt names a Community Outreach Corporation with an after-school mentoring and homework program, job-search help by appointment, and a monthly nursing home ministry. The article returned HTTP 429 twice, so no summary was written from it. Identity not confirmed: the article says Missionary Baptist, the IRS says Baptist, and a church directory lists 2010 Tasker Street while the IRS lists 2018 Tasker St. Needs a dated source before publishing.

records.name: Temple Community and Economic Development Corporation
records.notes: The website field held a CPA firm's name, not a web address, so no site was fetched. Not searched: the two-search budget was spent on Tasker Street and Redeemed for a Cause. The IRS listing gives 1327 S 19th St, unit 35. Needs a search or a site before any summary is written.

records.name: The Justinian Foundation
records.notes: A scholarship fund for law students who belong to Justinian Society student chapters, with eligibility that includes Italian ancestry and financial need. Applications go by mail. The fund is private, so it is hidden. The parent bar association is listed in leads_only.

records.name: A Sister's Heart
records.summary: A family-led nonprofit that supports breast cancer warriors and survivors. It shares education about preventive care, wellness resources, and compassionate outreach.
records.what_you_do: Ask the group how to join its community or attend an event. The site does not explain how to attend or volunteer.

cost.text: The site lists no event or membership fees. Its only money option is a donate button.

first_step.how: Email asistersheartinfo@gmail.com to ask how to join A Sisters Community or attend an upcoming event.
first_step.basis: The site names a community and events but does not say how to join or what to expect.

records.notes: The site has no dated items. Its social links point to generic Squarespace and Facebook accounts, so they were left out. The email is shown on the page next to a link that looked broken, so verify it before relying on it. The street address comes from the IRS listing (6131 Webster St), not the site.

records.name: Al-Hanifiyya Haven
records.notes: The website field held a stray character, not a web address, so no site was fetched. Not searched: the two-search budget was spent on Tasker Street and Redeemed for a Cause. IRS listing address: 5512 Belmar Ter.

records.name: Asian American Business Alliance of Greater Philadelphia
records.summary: A nonprofit that brings together Asian American and Pacific Islander business owners in the Philadelphia area. It runs workshops and networking, helps members with marketing and government relations, and holds galas and awards.
records.what_you_do: Join as a member through the Join the Membership link, then take part in workshops, networking, and events. The site does not describe volunteer roles.

schedule.text: The site shows a 2026 AAPI Heritage Month gala and a 2025 Golden Eagle Award, with no months given. It lists no workshop schedule.

cost.text: Membership prices are not listed on the site.

first_step.how: Use the Join the Membership link on the group's site, or call 215-880-1714 to ask about membership and upcoming events.
first_step.basis: You need to become a member before you see the programs in detail, and prices are not listed.

records.notes: Dated items show only years (2025 and 2026), with no months, so last_sign_of_life is left out. The site lists no public organization email. The IRS listing gives 5813 Thomas Ave, which differs from the site's address. The LinkedIn link is an individual's profile and the Instagram link is a single post, so both were left out.

records.name: Back on Track Community Outreach Services
records.summary: A community outreach nonprofit based in Harrisburg that says it serves Harrisburg, Philadelphia and nearby counties. It runs workshops, support groups, and community events, and helps people find resources.
records.what_you_do: Use the contact form on the group's site to ask about workshops, support groups, and events. The site does not describe a volunteer process.

cost.text: The site lists no cost for its programs.

first_step.how: Use the contact form on the group's site to ask how to join a workshop or support group.
first_step.basis: The site gives no sign-up steps, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The site gives 1821 Fulton Street, Harrisburg as its base. No Philadelphia meeting place or dated event is published, and the IRS listing gives a Philadelphia address (5249 Addison St). Check whether it meets in Philadelphia before showing it to visitors. The footer year range is not dated evidence.

records.name: Black Women in Computational Biology Network
records.summary: A professional network for Black women working in computational and quantitative biology. Members get a community, seminars, a member directory, and a podcast.
records.what_you_do: Join through the membership form, then use the member portal, the directory, and the seminars. The site does not describe volunteer roles.

cost.text: Membership is free at this time. Donations and sponsorships are optional.

first_step.how: Fill in the member application linked from the JOIN NOW button on the group's site.
first_step.basis: Membership needs an application form, so you see the member programs only after you join.

records.notes: The newest dated item the site shows is a 2023 impact report, so the status is dormant. This is a worldwide online network. The Philadelphia link comes from the IRS listing (3675 Market Street), not from the site, and the site does not mention Philadelphia. A reviewer should decide whether an online network with no Philadelphia meetings belongs here. The site text was cut off at the end.

records.name: Building Boys to Men
records.notes: A nonprofit whose main offer is a paid subscription educational video game (memberships from 1.99 to 19.99 dollars a month, plus a 9.99 dollar one-time unlock). The site lists no classes, meetings, volunteer roles, or in-person programs, so it is treated as a business with no community program. The free sampler is a product, not a group. The site address (2825 Ormes St) differs from the IRS listing (1018 S 55th St).

records.name: Caoba Foundation
records.notes: The site says the foundation is based in Jocotenango, Sacatepequez, Guatemala, and serves children and families there. The IRS listing gives 4918 Cedar Ave, Philadelphia, but the site names no Philadelphia programs.

leads_only.name: Justinian Society of Philadelphia
leads_only.note: Parent bar association named on the Justinian Foundation's page (attorneys of Italian ancestry, membership application, 2026 dated events listed). Read on that page only; needs its own record.

leads_only.name: Covenant House (Kensington)
leads_only.note: Named in a 2024 news article as a place Redeemed for a Cause delivered gifts to. Not checked.

blocked.note: Origin error on three attempts; Retry-After 120 seconds. No page read.
Rate limited on two attempts. Article seen only as a search excerpt, so not used for a summary.
TLS certificate names only bluehost.com, so the fetch tool refused the page (tried with and without www). Not a bot check.

notes: Searches: 2 of 2 used, both on Tasker Street and Redeemed for a Cause. Temple Community and Economic Development Corporation and Al-Hanifiyya Haven were not searched because the cap was reached, so both are unknown with no summary. Sisterhood 4 Vets was unreadable (HTTP 522 three times). Tasker Street's article was rate limited (HTTP 429) on two attempts. Redeemed for a Cause's own website would not load, so its record rests on two CBS Philadelphia news articles (February 2024 and February 2020). Three IRS website fields were not web addresses (an accounting firm, a CPA firm and a stray character), and those were treated as missing. Rate limiting hit one domain at a time, not many. Verdict counts: 12 publish (4 with unknown status and no summary), 1 hide (private), 1 hide (out_of_scope), 1 out_of_area.
